entry_points.text: Probe validates config, allocates state, inits workers with stop sync and ack wait, builds queues, optionally sets hint workqueue, list, shrinker, notifier, poison and reporting, then enables wakeup, marks ready and adjusts when off target.

Change and stats callbacks defer unless stopped, size path scheduling adjust plus hint and stats path scheduling stats work with distinct wakeups; quiesce unregisters services, blocks updates and cancels workers, remove also destroys workqueue, drains holdings, resets and deletes queues, freeze drains while restore rebuilds, marks ready, reevaluates and republishes.
Input driver registers for virtio input id with no extra features and binds probe, removal and freeze plus restore.

Hotplug notifier translates start to block id and dispatches per-mode, power notifier vetoes hibernation and restore prep; online callback scans devices under RCU, drops it before sleeping per-device call, falls back to generic when unmatched, onlining plugged ranges and leaving unplugged fake offline with narrowed granularity on mixed input.

exports.text: Balloon driver publishes feature and id tables and binds probe, remove, shutdown, config-change, validate and suspend-resume callbacks.
DMA helpers validate virtio buffers for export, delegate attach, test identity and fetch UUID; inbound helper adds device buffers with debug exemption.

hazards.text: Status suppresses multitouch timestamp echo, allocates atomically reporting exhaustion, uses little-endian, queues only while ready else absent-device, always signals after attempt, frees on queue failure; completion and teardown reclaim messages.

Growth can fail no-memory leaving old store; add can fail after accounting needing rollback; offline-plus-remove should succeed after isolation but may report busy or no-memory; big-block offline acts only in fake-offline, subblock going-offline and cancel skip plugged.
Protocol uses plug, unplug and unplug-all types with ack, nack, busy and error responses driving accounting and mapping.

invariants.text: Desired count is read little-endian and rounded to guest granularity, actual, poison and hint id use little-endian; poison and reporting require mem-init with indirect and platform access off and ring-derived order and capacity; pressure rounds to hint blocks, deflates fixed amount normalized by guest factor and republishes size.
Discovery writes selector pair then reads length; bitmaps arrive low-bit-first and truncate to caller size while recording event family; absolute axes publish range, resolution, fuzz and flat.

Probe needs modern negotiation, allocates state, takes event and status queues, copies truncated name and serial, derives path from index, sets bus id with virtual fallback, enumerates caps, configures axes and slots, then marks ready, registers and prefills.

Block ids derive from address division and multiplication with extent and subblock sizing; overlap and containment use base and length with NUMA defaulting to no-node unless ACPI present; tunables set default onlining, forced big-block mode and size override.

State is at id minus first with per-state counters asserted never to underflow; subblock state is one bitmap bit linear in offset with run set, clear and absence scans; growth is page-rounded by one entry, reusing store when page count unchanged, else allocating zeroed store outside locks, copying under mutex, swapping and freeing old bitmap after unlock.

Growth needs offline total plus size within threshold with pre-account and rollback on failure and subtraction and work requeue on removal; adds create persistent name once and register managed memory with merge and node-from-group at block granularity, removal mirrors addressing and normalizes failures to busy or no-memory.

Fake-offline drops one ref per page on going offline complaining if referenced, retakes on cancel, splits never-onlined versus onlined handling, onlines largest aligned power-of-two runs via generic path or contiguous release with count adjustment, and retries fake offline five times aborting on config change with movable-only retry and busy on exhaustion.

Requests copy into device storage with one out and one in element, add, kick, wait and interpret converted response, refusing on config change, deriving count from size, adjusting total only on ack and mapping negatives, with subblock address from base plus index and big-block from id, bitmap only on success, unplug-all clearing total and raising config-changed; prepare fails past last id, grows state and publishes id; plug-and-add plugs before exposing with compensating unplug; subblock plug fills partials under mutex then unused and new with rescheduling, big-block unused then new; unplug routes online via fake-offline plus host call and offline via raw path with mutex drops, visiting offline-partial through kernel reverse and reporting busy when demand remains; submission sleeps so never atomic.

locks.text: Stop flag uses stop lock in plain and irq-saving forms; hint list and counter use hint-list lock; migration try-locks balloon mutex and defers when contended, and under one hold inflates replacement then deflates source with per-page counts.
Event and status paths hold irq-saving guard while checking readiness and draining, drop it while delivering onward, then reacquire and revalidate before requeue and signal.

Global list and online callback use dedicated mutex installing callback on first insert and restoring on last remove with grace wait; per-device hotplug mutex stabilizes counts, state and bitmaps against transitions.

state_machines.text: Adjustment computes signed distance to aligned target, grows when positive, shrinks when negative, publishes actual, requeues while residual remains else completes wakeup.

Stats primes one buffer at init, then on signal consumes completion, refreshes values, offers fresh buffer sized to count and notifies, wrapped in wakeup begin and end; offer failure warns once and aborts without notify.

Hint reporting caches host id on demand, emits start after draining, offers large blocks while id unchanged, then emits stop; completion releases all blocks while stop or duplicate suppresses; exhaustion ends scan and other errors still try stop.

Subblock uses unused, plugged-only, offline, offline-partial, kernel, kernel-partial, movable, movable-partial with sentinel; big-block uses unused, plugged-only, added and fake-offline with sentinel.

Going-online accepts only from offline-like states else denies; offline maps online to matching offline variant; online picks kernel versus movable from first-page zone preserving partialness; fully unplugged blocks are offlined, removed and marked unused.

structs.text: Balloon instance holds device link, five queue handles, stats storage, size and stats workers with hint workqueue and work, stop and wakeup sync with ack wait, balloon mutex, hint list with count, id cache with active and stop, shrinker, notifier, reporting info and frame accounting.
Input state pairs host and core refs with three 64-char strings, event and status queues, 64-slot DMA-from-device pool, guard and ready marker.

Memory device holds linkage, unplug need, deferred work with counters, one queue with waiters and single request and response, sizes, block sizing and region, resource and group id, offline accounting with threshold, mode-selected subblock or big-block tracking, guards, flags, timing, notifiers, dump capture and list link.

Inflate and deflate queues always exist, stats, free-page and reporting only when negotiated; driver advertises tell-host, stats, deflate-on-pressure, hint, poison and reporting; free-page reporting needs ring of two with one reserved for ids.
Offline allowance before throttling is one gibibyte; plug retry spans fifty thousand to three hundred thousand milliseconds.
